items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I am not a Trump supporter in any way, particularly of the Mitch McConnell and all the Senate starting way back from Paul Ryan and Lindsay Graham.

ctx.x: It’s self-destructive, yeah. Speaking of the government do you have — how do you feel about what your state has done or the federal government? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

I think — I can’t figure out if they — if this is part of a — if the GOP has become a cult or if they all have the same form of mental illness. I mean I really don’t know.
